description: This file defines API route handlers for a notes application, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes. It uses FastAPI to create RESTful routes and depends on a service layer for business logic.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: list_notes( limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=1000, description="Maximum number of notes to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of notes to skip from the start"), svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list notes with optional pagination.

methods.name: get_note( note_id: UUID = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by UUID.

methods.name: create_note( payload: NoteCreate, svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: update_note( note_id: UUID = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), payload: NoteUpdate = ..., svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by UUID.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: UUID = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by UUID.

ctags.signature: ( note_id: UUID = Path(..., description="UUID of the note"), svc: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
